hooks.command: input="$(cat)"; case "$input" in *docker*) f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/python/agents/slot.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "slot guard: $f is missing, so a command naming docker is blocked" >&2; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$input" | uv run --no-project --quiet python -I "$f" hook; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; [ "$s" -eq 2 ] || echo "slot guard: the hook could not run (exit $s), so the call is blocked" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
